# OmniaOps

> OmniaOps is a supply chain planning platform for mid-market manufacturers. It covers demand, supply, inventory and capacity planning in one place, with AI agents that run the planning routines a team defines. OmniaOps ApS was founded in 2026 and is based in Birkerød, greater Copenhagen, Denmark.

Key facts:
- Customers get an Excel import running and full access with their own data in under two weeks; full ERP integration takes 4-6 weeks depending on modules and data maturity.
- Live ERP integrations: SAP Business One and Microsoft Business Central. Any ERP with an API can be connected in 4-6 weeks.
- Typical annual subscription: USD 40,000-120,000 depending on sites, SKUs, users and modules.
- Founder: Philip L. Valentin, 8+ years leading supply chain and operations teams at Novo Nordisk, Ambu and WSA.
